title: Kagamine Len — Ways To Get Involved〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why can't you just tell her to not look? She might be your mother, but she has no right to just rummage through your computer without your permission.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think she did it because she was worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being worried about you doesn't give her permission to do what she did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, weren't you bothered by what happened? This is usually when you have to put your foot down.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I wonder how Mafuyu feels after what happened. She didn't look all that good...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(There's MEIKO...
But is it really okay for me to go talk to her...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What are you doing hiding over there, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Th-There's...!
There's something I want to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, next... Move the string off of your thumb and try to take the outermost string from below.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Like this...?
Alright, what's next.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Len, hello. We're playing cat's cradle. Would you like to join us? I'm currently trying to make a Jacob's ladder with six steps.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Unfortunately, she's had to remake it a bunch of times after messing up the same part over and over...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's quite difficult, so it seems only natural for me to run into walls and make some mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've sort of been plowing through then... Anyway, did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, um... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku...
I didn't mean to interrupt your singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I've been going around asking everyone about the best way to help Mafuyu and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... I decided to ask everyone about how they've helped Mafuyu and the others in the hopes that it'll give me a clue as to what I can do for them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were they able to give you some answers...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, MEIKO told me about how Ena came to thank her for what she did this one time, but MEIKO said, “I hadn't planned on helping her.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin told me about the time she helped deliver the song Kanade had made to Ena...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Luka mentioned this other time when she gave some advice to Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And now I want to hear from you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you here to see how Len's doing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Very astute of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's been wandering all around SEKAI because he's been worried about Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't blame him. He just arrived here not too long ago so he probably has no idea what to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If only I were as decisive as MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He must be with Miku now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... At the same time, he should just work up the guts to go and see her directly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that he still doesn't understand how just being there by their side can also help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which would explain why he came to speak with all of us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Regardless, I'm sure Miku will know what to tell him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, she's been here the longest and knows the others the best out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...
